Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Novamed's compliance team is preparing for an internal DPIA & external audit the week of May 24, and we need to gather vendor evidence now. We're hoping Redwood can provide the following items by May 14 so we can bundle them into our submission: 

- Excerpt of your Article 30 processing register showing activities relevant to healthcare workloads (redacted where needed).
- Current subprocessor inventory with effective dates and geographic locations.
- Copies or summaries of contractual safeguards used for EU->US transfers (SCCs or equivalent) and the implementation status.
- Sample KMS key rotation / access logs (redacted to tenant IDs) covering Mar–Apr 2027.
- Sample access/authentication logs for a 7-day window (we'll accept a redacted CSV).
- Evidence of audit rights / how we can execute an on-site or remote audit (scope, lead time, tech contact).
- Any DPIA support docs you provide to customers (playbook, typical artifacts).

I've attached our compliance questionnaire (tab: vendor_evidence) and a scope matrix. Please let me know if any of these items require formal legal review or an NDA.

Best,
Helena

2) Are you seeking executed SCC documents or a vendor attestation + redacted template? Executed SCCs often include customer-specific addenda.

Ben, Grace, Laura — looping you in to handle the log export, legal review queue, and coord on the audit playbook. Ben: can you confirm extraction params and any PII redaction we should apply?

Marissa — noted. For the log exports:

- We can produce redacted KMS rotation logs and Cloud key access entries. Format: CSV with columns (timestamp, key_id_redacted, action, principal_redacted, region).
- For auth/access logs we can provide an aggregated CSV (timestamp, tenant_id_redacted, endpoint, action, source_ip_redacted).
- Redaction policy: tenant_id -> hashed prefix (first 8 chars), IPs -> /24 masked.
- Extraction window ok: we'll default to 2027-04-18 to 2027-04-24 unless Novamed requests another week.

On SCCs: Legal (Laura) flagged a few inbound partner addenda that require review before we share executed copies. We can share our SCC template and a summary of implemented technical and organizational measures now. If Novamed needs executed copies tied to their agreement, Legal will require a DPA or NDA signed (standard).

I will create the Drive folder and upload samples by 2027-05-12. We should also prepare a short binding statement describing the scope of the exported logs (what was redacted, sampling methodology).
